compounding_issues: Every session failed with 'Failed to authenticate: OAuth session expired and could not be refreshed' — 0 tokens, 0 cost, 0 code produced in all 5 sessions; the 'story' is a cascade of identical auth failures, not an incremental build

The runner continued through all 5 sessions (greenfield → feature_addition → integration → refactor → cross_cutting) despite each exit_code=1, committing only a 3-line .instrument failure log per session instead of aborting at the first auth error

The known Claude OAuth clearing failure mode (AGENTS.md / docs/postmortems/claude_oauth_clearing.md) was not mitigated — the credential backup (~/.local/bin/claude_cred_watch.py --restore) was not restored before or during the run
The seed commit is a single 250-line app.py despite being described as a multi-file ~500 LOC tier2 codebase, so even the nominal foundation the sessions were supposed to extend is truncated
app.py is byte-identical from seed to final commit (git diff 8c68cc7..2820ba2 empty) — no session touched the codebase at all
key_decisions: Running all five sessions to completion against a dead OAuth session, preserving the nominal 5-commit story shape (seed + 5 session commits) with zero substantive changes
Committing the per-session .instrument session logs (session.jsonl/session_1..5.jsonl) as the only content of each 'session' commit
Seeding with a single-file Flask app.py instead of the declared multi-file tier2 structure, giving later sessions no real module surface to extend

story_review.trajectory_description: Quality is flat at zero across all five sessions: every session produced an identical 2-second failure (OAuth session expired), zero tokens, and zero lines of code, with each commit merely appending another 3-line error log. There is no improvement or degradation arc because no agent work ever occurred — the trajectory is a constant auth-failure plateau, and the only measurable artifact is the 250-line untouched seed.
story_review.summary: This is not a coherent multi-session build but a fully failed run where all five sessions hit the documented Claude OAuth credential-clearing failure and produced no code whatsoever, so the commit sequence has nominal structure but no engineering content.
